title: Square of Sum
description: Expands the square of the sum of two algebraic terms.
note: The middle term is always twice the product of the two terms.

title: Square of Difference
description: Expands the square of the difference of two algebraic terms.
note: Only the middle term is negative.

title: Difference of Squares
description: Factorizes the difference of two perfect squares into the product of the sum and difference of the terms.
note: Applicable only when both terms are perfect squares.

title: Product of Two Binomials
description: Expands the product of two binomials having the same variable term.
note: Add the constants to obtain the coefficient of x and multiply them to obtain the constant term.

title: Square of Three Terms
description: Expands the square of the sum of three algebraic terms.
note: Square each term and add twice the product of every pair of terms.

title: Cube of Sum
description: Expands the cube of the sum of two algebraic terms.

title: Cube of Difference
description: Expands the cube of the difference of two algebraic terms.

title: Sum of Cubes
description: Factorizes the sum of two cubes into the product of a binomial and a quadratic expression.
note: The middle sign inside the quadratic factor is always negative.

title: Difference of Cubes
description: Factorizes the difference of two cubes into the product of a binomial and a quadratic expression.
note: The middle sign inside the quadratic factor is always positive.

title: Fourth Power Identity
formula: a⁴ + b⁴ + a²b² = (a² + b² + ab)(a² + b² - ab)
description: Factorizes the expression containing fourth powers and the product of squares into two quadratic factors.

example.question: Factorize x⁴ + x²y² + y⁴.
example.solution: x⁴ + x²y² + y⁴ = (x² + y² + xy)(x² + y² - xy).

note: A useful identity for factorizing fourth-degree expressions.

title: Sum of Three Cubes
formula: a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² - ab - bc - ca)
description: Factorizes the expression involving the sum of three cubes and the product of the three variables.

example.question: Factorize x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz.
example.solution: (x + y + z)(x² + y² + z² - xy - yz - zx).

note: One of the most important identities involving three variables.

title: Alternate Form of Sum of Three Cubes
formula: a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = (a + b + c)[(a - b)² + (b - c)² + (c - a)²] / 2
description: Expresses the identity involving the sum of three cubes in terms of the squared differences of the variables.

example.question: Express x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz in the alternate factorized form.

note: This is an equivalent form of the identity a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca).

title: Special Case (a + b + c = 0)
formula: If a + b + c = 0, then a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc
description: A special result obtained from the sum of three cubes identity when the sum of the three variables is zero.

example.question: If x + y + z = 0, simplify x³ + y³ + z³.

note: This identity follows directly from the previous formula by substituting a + b + c = 0.
